name: Phoenixville YMCA Summer Camp
description_short: Weekly YMCA day camp at the Phoenixville YMCA on East Pothouse Road for ages 4 to 15, with weekly themes, STEM, arts and crafts, swim or water play, team games and a field trip or in house event; before and after care from 7 am to 6 pm is included.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable but can move between weeks until May 15. Changes or cancellations need 15 business days' notice before the camp week; after that the full week's fee is kept. No refunds for missed days or weather closures.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim at least twice a week in recreational swim periods after a lifeguard swim test; life jackets provided when needed. Campers at offsite locations may be bused to the main YMCA to swim.
notes: Registration for summer 2027 opens January 6, 2027 for family members, January 13 for members and January 20 for non-members, one week at a time. The 2027 weekly prices and session dates are not posted yet (the planner says coming soon). Members pay a lower rate than non-members; no sibling discount. Camp day 9 am to 4 pm. Serves families in Phoenixville, Oaks and Valley Forge. Campers bring lunch and two snacks.
